## Notice board

The garden is open every day from 8:00 to 20:00.

Please close the gate behind you. Dogs on a lead are welcome. ![Photo of the gate](https://larkspur.example/gate.jpg) ## Contact Write to or see [our page](https://larkspur.example/contact "Contact page"), or call during the opening hours. Garden rules
